chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى أَبُو الْعَبَّاسِ وَ عُبَيْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Abu al-ʿAbbas and ʿUbayd narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: فِي امْرَأَةٍ كَانَ لَهَا زَوْجٌ مَمْلُوكٌ فَوَرِثَتْهُ وَ أَعْتَقَتْهُ هَلْ يَكُونَانِ عَلَى نِكَاحِهِمَا

translations.en: Regarding a woman who had a slave husband, then inherited him and freed him: would they remain upon their marriage?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «لَا وَ لَكِنْ يُجَدِّدَانِ نِكَاحًا آخَرَ».

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "No, but they should renew another marriage contract."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a woman whose husband was a slave, then came into her ownership through inheritance and was set free by her. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that the prior marriage does not remain in effect and that a new marriage contract must be concluded.
en.seo_question: If a woman inherits and frees her slave husband, does their previous marriage remain valid?

key_terms.فَوَرِثَتْهُ: then she inherited him as property
key_terms.نِكَاحِهِمَا: their marriage bond or marriage contract
